quality_effect: Constrains OS Terrain50 to broad independent corroboration rather than parcel-scale precision.
verified_facts: OS Terrain50 grid data is verified to 4m RMSE
Its accuracy was compared with GPS points across multiple geographic area types
The 4m figure applies to grid height points
Terrain50 is designed to be INSPIRE-ready
Terrain50 is not a parcel-boundary source
Terrain50 should be treated as coarser than EA 1m DTM
Independent corroboration must not replace primary numeric elevation evidence
